extracted_data.text: Description  The Air Science Fuming Chamber uses cyanoacrylate fuming for latent print development on various surfaces. The fuming chamber incorporates the Air Science Fume Extraction unit coupled with a self-contained filtration system to safely purge the noxious fumes when the printing cycle is complete.
extracted_data.html:
Description

The Air Science Fuming Chamber uses cyanoacrylate fuming for latent print development on various surfaces. The fuming chamber incorporates the Air Science Fume Extraction unit coupled with a self-contained filtration system to safely purge the noxious fumes when the printing cycle is complete.
